stage2.rule: gat and gat_noembed, plus the 2 physics variants with the highest inner-validation score: seed-0 runs, each fold's chosen inner-validation net (before the refit) scored on that fold's inner-validation cases with the harness's 20 seeded sensor sets; score = mean over k in {2, 3, 4, 6, 8} of the case-weighted mean over the 5 folds of case-level top-3. Ties (equal to 0.1 point) are broken by inner small-leak top-3 at k = 8 (to 0.1 point), then by fewer added inputs (prior < node < edge; mid < all levels), then by name. Outer-fold results are not used.

noembed_adoption.rule: adopt node_embed: 0 as the default for M11 on if, with seeds 0, 1 and 2 of both gat and gat_noembed over all 5 folds, the paired top-3 difference (gat_noembed - gat, all cases, seed-averaged per case) has its 95% CI lower bound above 0 at k = 8 and a point estimate >= 0 at every k; otherwise keep the embedding
